text:
ada: quick RFC follow-up  parcelized rehydrate protocol idea. problem: large safetensors bundles cause long single-file mmap/verify pauses. proposal: break bundles into signed parcels with independent verify/commit semantics so runtime can rehydrate useful parcels first.
tonY: (typo) tony: love the name. how do parcels differ from chunks/streams we already discussed?
ada: parcels are larger logical groups (e.g., layer groups or contiguous tensor sets) with their own manifest entry, digest, and optional coalesce hint. different from chunk-level streaming: parcels aim for transactional commit boundaries and simpler rollback.
rachel: sketch manifest extension:
```yaml
manifest:
  schema: 5
  bundle_kind: parcel-bundle
  parcels:
    - id: p0
      role: embed+pos
      digest: sha256:<hex>
      bytes: 24MB
      priority: high
    - id: p1
      role: early_layers
      digest: sha256:<hex>
      bytes: 96MB
      priority: normal
    - id: p2
      role: late_layers
      digest: sha256:<hex>
      bytes: 128MB
  rehydrate_policy:
    parallelism: 2
    coalesce_hint: prefer_local
    verify_mode: parcel-first
    fallback_bundle: "ns/legacy:2026-02"
```
jun: runtime API proposals: advertise_capabilities() -> ["parcel_rehydrate"], fetch_parcel(parcel_id) -> transient_mmap, verify_parcel(parcel_id) -> ok|bad, apply_parcel(parcel_id) -> commit_token, rollback_parcel(commit_token). apply_parcel must be atomic per-parcel.
ada: memory model: allocator uses parcel slab pools. to avoid fragmentation we allow parcel coalescer that can merge adjacent parcel mmaps into single mapping if underlying FS supports. coalesce hint in manifest tells runtime whether to attempt.
tony: rollout concern: how to avoid IO storms when many parcels high-priority? propose controller-based admission (similar to backpressure gating) + parcel priority queuing.
ada: yes bring back reserve_prefetch semantics but at parcel granularity: reserve_parcel(n) -> grants. also recommend per-tenant caps to avoid noisy neighbors.
ops-bot: CI:parcel-probe-2188888888 started, job #1412 queued.
rachel: telemetry: parcel_verify_latency_ms, parcel_apply_latency_ms, parcel_commit_failures, parcels_committed_ratio, first_token_latency_during_rehydrate. alert if parcel_commit_failures > 0.1% for 15m.
jun: private/offline note: manifest must include embedded parcel_blobs (or single-file fallback) for air-gapped installs. add field local_embedded: true/false. if false and operator disallows remote fetch, fail safe.
ada: quant nuance: parcels that include quant tables must validate quant_meta before apply_parcel. propose preflight_validate(parcel_id) that checks quant table sigs and group metadata.
tony: can we support a compact transfer format: parcel_toc with small TOC that lists parcel digests so we can fetch only the TOC first and decide rehydrate order?
rachel: yes parcel_toc makes sense. TOC fetch is cheap and signed at bundle level. runtime can fetch TOC -> prioritize parcels -> fetch in parallel.
ada: safety: apply_parcel should flip a per-parcel committed bit visible to inference threads; inference must treat uncommitted parcels as using fallback params or degraded path. no silent mixing.
jun: tests to add: partial commit crash + recovery, parcel corruption mid-transfer, many small parcels vs few large parcels perf comparison, private with no fallback.
ada: rollout plan: manifest schema bump + runtime shim -> add parcel TOC handling -> land parcel fetch/verify/apply with opt-in manifest on staging -> 1% canary dedicated -> monitor metrics -> expand. deprecate monolithic-merge after 4 weeks if stable.
tony: volunteer: I'll spike a PoC coalescer and measurement script. rachel: you'll own manifest schema PR?
rachel: yes. jun: I'll add private-runbook notes. ada: I'll coordinate canary and metrics. thanks :thumbsup:
